name: toolbar
title: Toolbar
description: A small raised sheet that holds a row of quiet controls.
use: A row of small quiet buttons, selects and segmented controls that act on one thing: formatting tools, a selection bar. Give the container role="toolbar" and a label.

instead.when: The buttons join into one shape and need no sheet
The row picks one of a few options
The bar is the top of the page and holds navigation

keyboard.action: Moves to the next control; without a script every control is a tab stop
With a script that keeps one tab stop, move between the controls

classes.name: toolbar
classes.description: The raised row, 40px tall around 32px controls, with a 4px inset

classes.name: toolbar-floating
classes.description: On the floating surface, for tools that sit over content

classes.name: toolbar-separator
classes.description: A short rule between groups of controls
